'''Shadow Blitz''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 76 and can do a maximum of 24 damage per hit.

Shadow Blitz has the ability to lower your target's [[Attack]] level by 15%, this effect '''does not''' stack to lower the target's Attack level to zero.

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest is required to cast this spell.

When used against the [[Abyssal Sire]], Shadow Blitz has a 75% chance of disorienting it for the first phase of the fight.
